high1_exact_candidate_composition.target_construction: A separate target worktree is created from exact Slice7 commit 751162ee42c603cb6c84ee12021d16bab6fa626b; proposal-branch HEAD is never the candidate base.
pre_materialization_checks: target HEAD equals exact Slice7 base
target commit tree equals exact base
frozen schema subtree at Slice7 base equals frozen schema candidate
high1_exact_candidate_composition.materialization: Only the 120 exact reviewed allowlist entries are checked out into target from exact reviewed source commits.
high1_exact_candidate_composition.final_diff_oracle: Before and after test execution, staged diff from Slice7 base must equal exactly the 120 allowlisted paths plus one non-authoritative candidate manifest; any missing or extra path hard-fails.
high1_exact_candidate_composition.commit_boundary: No broad git add is used. Selected paths are staged only by exact source checkout; only the single candidate manifest is explicitly git-added. Commit/push occurs only after exact-diff verification and strict oracle PASS.
high1_exact_candidate_composition.candidate_excludes: Proposal branch governance, review packets, activation artifact, integration machinery and other unselected changes are not inherited into target.

high2_inherited_baseline_identity.identity_manifest: 11 exact baseline test path+mode+type+blob entries bound to Slice7 base
high2_inherited_baseline_identity.preflight_check: all 11 baseline test identities verified before materialization
high2_inherited_baseline_identity.oracle_check: all 11 baseline test identities reverified immediately before execution
high2_inherited_baseline_identity.result_rule: structured unittest TestResult must report zero failures, errors, skips, expectedFailures and unexpectedSuccesses; aggregate testsRun must equal 140

medium_governance_history_io.rule: AST path classification distinguishes permitted frozen-schema reads under schemas/governance-r8/v15-r1 from prohibited governance-history root reads.
medium_governance_history_io.coverage: receiver-based read_text/read_bytes/open patterns and simple variable propagation are checked.

medium_test_bypass_detection.rule: No prose-marker parsing is used. Child unittest runner emits structured TestResult JSON for testsRun, failures, errors, skipped, expectedFailures, unexpectedSuccesses and successful.

medium_broad_staging.rule: Workflow contains no broad git add for candidate construction; final commit consumes only exact staged reviewed entries plus exact candidate manifest.

stage1_protocol.activation_precondition: Fresh independent BOUNDED_PASS with zero Critical/High plus explicit user approval of the exact Successor2 proposal commit.
activation_binding: exact Successor2 proposal commit and blob

reviewed_slice_test_oracle.per_slice: 20 for S20-S22; 16 for every other S8-S46 slice

stage2.rule: No semantic/currentness/qualification/evidence-promotion work until the exact Stage1 integrated candidate receives a separate fresh independent review and subsequent separately preregistered semantic gate approval.
